name: basilico
description: Run and report on your work sessions from the terminal: a focus timer with cycles, tasks and real statistics.

interface.shortDescription: A focus timer you can drive from a terminal
interface.longDescription: Start, pause and end focus sessions; track interruptions; keep a today plan; and read back what the day actually looked like. The same domain core as the basilico web app, so the log and the export are interchangeable.
defaultPrompt: Where am I in my cycle?
